state.present: Every M1 WaveState coordinate except closure_memory and retained_rebalancing; wrapper placeholders required empty to prevent duplication
state.memory: M1 immutable retained return identities, separate coordinate
state.retention: Only storage for prior FRG rebalancing residual and its source/target wave, committed contact, lineage/scope, operand and phase provenance
state.present_projection: X; matched controls also hold Mclosure and immutable admitted world equal
state.law: Declared exact model J_next=J+(A+q+g*sum(available_i*r_i))/p; A is unchanged present pressure-bearing attention, q separately declared perturbation, g model gain; native update supplies J+A/p first; all effects committed at k+1
state.admissible_response: Selected H1 continuation on already admitted Q4 support; later fold/contact requires separate M1 certificates
state.no_hidden_channel: X.retained_rebalancing and X.closure_memory are empty; historical causal values live only in R; evidence lane names and traces cannot enter U
state.scope: Operational finite model; no new universal dynamics, observer, phenomenology or metrology
state.residual_constructor: R.value = FRG(independent Q tuple, cross Q tuple).residual = sum(cross); R holds these committed prior operands, source/target wave IDs, real native repeated contacts, native signed-lag comparison and commitment. Both operands are declared pressure-bearing channel contributions; n.aod_flux and n.frg retain provenance and exact AO=-OA.
state.world_read_boundary: Immutable world may validate admitted waves, contact/action provenance and causal order only. U cannot derive or recover absent R values from world, closure memory, traces or caches. Only present attention and R values explicitly retained in the state contribute to response.

primary_lanes: ineffective retention via separately declared zero-gain family
controls.pressure: Separate p=1 and p=2 families, retention matched within each; cross-pressure pair rejected
controls.exact_restoration: Value plus full lineage/provenance, not a matching scalar alone
controls.randomness: Deterministic exact rational model; no seed claim or stochastic inference
controls.strict_order: prior contact through k-1, retained rebalancing committed at k, effect only after k
controls.phase: M1 signed relational lag and directional RCD, with wave/contact prefix binding; selector, wrapped display and metrology substitutions rejected
controls.query_provenance: Each event retains the consumed observation cut. Immediate q_k=-J_k cites k; delayed q_k=-J_(k-1) cites k-1. Delayed fixture starts with explicitly declared J_32=0 and J_33=3; later source values are recorded observations.

runtime_delta: Source-bound prior operand commitments, full inherited immutable-state validation, exact native integer cuts, actual action-return projection, and independent second-hop retained intervention enforce this specification. Comparator bias is an exact two-operand tuple. Every declared outer certificate carries its actual inner wave pair and scope map: both B1 comparison operands and the B2 fold. An outer tag without that witness is rejected.
